title: BUG: static — a friendly unit played from facedown (not from hand) has Accelerate and may pay [1][fury] to enter ready

repro.testName: BUG: static — a friendly unit played from facedown (not from hand) has Accelerate and may pay [1][fury] to enter ready

history.note: needs missing engine capability: revealHidden move has no optional-cost params (moves.ts revealHidden={playerId,cardId}) and getOptionalPlayCost only reads a card's own printed Accelerate keyword, so a static-granted Accelerate on a facedown play cannot be offered or paid
